title: The Economy Contracts
description: Unemployment is climbing and economists are calling it: the country has slipped into recession.

options.label: Push an emergency stimulus package
options.description: Rush direct aid and infrastructure spending through Congress.

options.label: Hold the line on spending
options.description: Resist new spending and let automatic stabilizers do the work.

options.label: Cut taxes to spur investment
options.description: A targeted business tax cut aimed at reviving growth.

options.label: Let markets correct on their own
options.description: Avoid intervention and trust the business cycle.

title: Category 5 Hurricane Makes Landfall
description: A catastrophic hurricane has devastated coastal communities, with billions in damage and thousands displaced.

options.label: Launch a full federal disaster response
options.description: Deploy FEMA at full scale with generous rebuilding funds.

options.label: Let states lead with limited federal aid
options.description: Provide modest federal support and defer to state emergency management.

options.label: Rebuild with climate resilience funding
options.description: Pair disaster relief with investment in storm-resistant infrastructure.

title: Regional Conflict Escalates
description: Fighting between rival regional powers threatens to draw in American allies.

options.label: Deploy military support to allies
options.description: Send forces to reinforce treaty allies in the region.

options.label: Pursue a diplomatic-only response
options.description: Rely on sanctions and negotiation rather than force.

options.label: Provide arms and funding without troops
options.description: Back allies materially while keeping American forces out of direct combat.

options.label: Stay fully out of it
options.description: Decline involvement entirely.

title: A Novel Virus Spreads
description: A fast-moving respiratory virus is spreading nationwide, straining hospitals in several states.

options.label: Mandate public health measures
options.description: Order masking and capacity limits in affected areas.

options.label: Issue voluntary guidelines only
options.description: Protect the economy by leaving precautions to individual choice.

options.label: Launch a rapid vaccine development push
options.description: Fund an all-out push to develop and distribute a vaccine.

options.label: Respond only in the hardest-hit regions
options.description: A narrowly targeted, region-specific response.

title: Administration Official Embroiled in Scandal
description: A senior official faces allegations that are dominating the news cycle.

options.label: Fire the official immediately
options.description: Cut ties quickly to limit the political damage.

options.label: Stand by them and call it a political attack
options.description: Defend the official publicly and dismiss the allegations.

options.label: Order an independent investigation
options.description: Let a independent inquiry determine the facts before acting.

title: Mass Shooting Shocks the Nation
description: A mass shooting has left the country in mourning and reignited the national debate over guns.

options.label: Push for stricter gun legislation
options.description: Call on Congress to pass new firearm restrictions.

options.label: Focus on mental health funding
options.description: Fund mental-health services while defending gun rights.

options.label: Increase public security funding
options.description: Fund additional security measures at schools and public venues.

options.label: Offer condolences and take no new action
options.description: Express sympathy without proposing policy change.

title: A Supreme Court Seat Opens
description: A justice's retirement gives you a nomination that will shape the Court for a generation.

options.label: Nominate a progressive jurist
options.description: Pick a nominee favored by the party's left flank.

options.label: Nominate a conservative jurist
options.description: Pick a nominee favored by the party's right flank.

options.label: Nominate a consensus centrist
options.description: Pick a nominee designed to draw votes from both parties.

title: Migrant Crossings Surge at the Border
description: A sharp rise in border crossings is straining local resources and dominating headlines.

options.label: Deploy additional enforcement
options.description: Send more personnel and resources to the border.

options.label: Expand humanitarian processing capacity
options.description: Add staff and facilities to process claims faster and more humanely.

options.label: Negotiate a regional migration agreement
options.description: Work with neighboring governments on a coordinated response.

title: Major Union Strike Disrupts Industry
description: A nationwide strike has halted production across a major industry.

options.label: Side with striking workers publicly
options.description: Voice support for the union's demands.

options.label: Push for a swift back-to-work deal
options.description: Pressure both sides toward a settlement favoring continuity.

options.label: Broker a neutral mediated settlement
options.description: Bring in federal mediators to find middle ground.

title: Cyberattack Hits Critical Infrastructure
description: A sophisticated cyberattack has disrupted power and water systems in several states.

options.label: Launch a retaliatory cyber operation
options.description: Respond in kind against the suspected source.

options.label: Invest heavily in defensive cybersecurity
options.description: Fund a major upgrade to critical-infrastructure protections.

options.label: Pursue diplomatic sanctions only
options.description: Respond through sanctions rather than escalation.

title: Border Communities Strain Under Enforcement Surge
description: The border security buildup you funded is overwhelming local services in the towns hosting it.

options.label: Deploy federal aid to affected border communities
options.description: Send emergency funding to offset the strain.

options.label: Stay the course with no additional funding
options.description: Let local governments absorb the cost.

title: Coal Country Reels From the Energy Transition
description: The clean-energy transition you championed is costing jobs faster than expected in coal-dependent regions.

options.label: Fund a coal-country retraining program
options.description: Invest in job retraining for displaced energy workers.

options.label: Take no additional action
options.description: Let the market absorb the transition.
